mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity and CNS stimulation; tramadol inhibits serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake while methylphenidate increases catecholamine release, creating additive CNS and serotonergic effects with seizure risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome, seizures, and excessive CNS stimulation.
